_doc: Event definition - VARIABLE so we can test (Mike 2026-07-30: 'we just need to be able to vary whatever we use so that we can test - its all about the data'). mode: 'magnitude' = |move %| >= per-kind threshold; 'percentile' = top X% vs trailing N years; 'either' = qualifies under one or the other; 'both' = must qualify under both. All flags are kept in the catalog so switching modes never loses data. See docs/CONCEPTS.md section 7.
